backend/main.mo: Main backend actor implementing enquiries, user profiles, and admin email authorization with AccessControl and migration support.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module converting old actor state to new structure by adding an initialization flag.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping feature IDs to affected frontend files, components, and test requirements.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of each frontend file in the project.
frontend/DEPLOYED_PUBLIC_URL.md: Documentation of the live deployment URLs, usage recommendations, and verification details.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT_OUTPUT.md: Automatically generated deployment record with canister info, URLs, and validation checklist.
frontend/GOOGLE_INDEXING_GUIDE.md: Guide for setting up Google Search Console and sitemap submission for the deployed site.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles defining OKLCH color variables for light and dark themes with global CSS rules.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry page defining metadata, SEO tags, fonts, favicons, and mounting the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/public/robots.txt: Robots.txt allowing all crawlers and pointing to the sitemap at /sitemap.xml.
frontend/public/sitemap.xml: XML sitemap listing the root URL with weekly change frequency and priority 1.0.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app that switches between home sections and the enquiries view, updating runtime metadata on load.
frontend/src/components/layout/Footer.ts: Footer component showing branding, contact links, quick navigation, and URL copy functionality.
frontend/src/components/layout/Header.ts: Header component with logo, navigation links, mobile menu, and scroll-to-section logic.
frontend/src/components/sections/AboutSe: About section displaying organization highlights using cards and descriptive text.
frontend/src/components/sections/Contact: Contact form section with validation, enquiry submission logic, and contact info display.
frontend/src/components/sections/Coverag: Coverage section describing primary and secondary regions served, plus benefits of regional expertise.
frontend/src/components/sections/Enquiri: Admin-facing enquiries dashboard handling authentication, profile management, admin email management, and marking enquiries as answered.
frontend/src/components/sections/FaqSect: Displays a FAQ accordion with predefined questions and answers about counselling services.
frontend/src/components/sections/HeroSec: Landing hero section with headline, CTAs, stats, and an image for the admission counselling service.
frontend/src/components/sections/Process: Shows a five-step counselling process using cards with icons and descriptions.
frontend/src/components/sections/Service: Renders a grid of service cards describing various admission counselling offerings.
frontend/src/components/sections/Testimo: Displays testimonial cards with quotes, ratings, and student details.
frontend/src/constants/admin.ts: Provides email normalization utilities and deprecated hardcoded admin email validation helpers.
frontend/src/constants/contact.ts: Exports shared constants for contact phone and email information.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor tied to the Internet Identity session and refreshes dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdmin.ts: Provides hooks to check whether the caller is an admin or authorized for enquiries using backend authorization calls.
frontend/src/hooks/useEnquiryAdminEmails: Hooks to fetch, add, and remove authorized admin emails via backend actor calls with automatic query invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity context provider and hook managing login, stored identities, and authentication state.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides enquiry-related hooks to fetch all enquiries, mark them answered, and create new ones using the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserProfile.ts: Hooks for fetching and saving the caller's user profile with appropriate query invalidations.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining theme variables for light and dark modes and base styling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry that sets up React Query and the Internet Identity provider before rendering the app.
frontend/src/utils/runtimePublicUrl.ts: Updates metadata and canonical URL at runtime to prefer a short alias domain.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters including sessionStorage-backed persistence.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, typography, animations, container settings, and includes several plugins.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata, existing features, and new admin-related feature requests for enquiries access management.
